Top Traffic Sources Chart¶

In [32]:
plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))

sns.barplot(
    x='Traffic_Source',
    y='Sessions',
    data=traffic_source
)

plt.title("Traffic Sources")
plt.show()

Donut Chart¶

In [33]:
traffic_source = df.groupby(
    'Traffic_Source'
)['Sessions'].sum()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))

plt.pie(
    traffic_source,
    labels=traffic_source.index,
    autopct='%1.1f%%'
)

centre_circle = plt.Circle(
    (0,0),
    0.60,
    fc='white'
)

fig = plt.gcf()

fig.gca().add_artist(
    centre_circle
)

plt.title("Traffic Source Distribution")

plt.show()

Sessions Trend¶

In [35]:
daily_sessions = df.groupby(
    'Date'
)['Sessions'].sum()
In [36]:
plt.figure(figsize=(14,6))

plt.plot(
    daily_sessions.index,
    daily_sessions.values
)

plt.title("Sessions Trend")

plt.xlabel("Date")
plt.ylabel("Sessions")

plt.show()

Area Chart¶

In [37]:
plt.figure(figsize=(14,6))

plt.fill_between(
    daily_sessions.index,
    daily_sessions.values,
    alpha=0.5
)

plt.plot(
    daily_sessions.index,
    daily_sessions.values,
    linewidth=2
)

plt.title("Website Traffic Trend")

plt.show()
